Class AddGoodsState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.server.model.state.GameState
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.server.model.state.AdventureState
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.server.model.state.AddGoodsState
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameStateInterface
public final class AddGoodsState extends AdventureState implements GameStateInterface
Represents the state of the game where a player is adding goods to their ship board. This state allows the player to add or remove goods from their ship board based on the available goods in their buffer.

    • addGood

      public void addGood(ShipBoard shipBoard, Point position, GoodsType good)
      Adds a good to the specified position on the ship board. Calls ShipBoard.placeGoods(Point, GoodsType, int) to add a good to the ship board. Removes the added good from the buffer.
      Overrides:
      addGood in class GameState
      Parameters:
      shipBoard - the ship board gaining the good
      position - the position to add the good
      good - the type of good to add
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if it's not the player's turn

    • removeGood

      public void removeGood(ShipBoard shipBoard, Point position, GoodsType good)
      Removes a good of the specified type from the given position on the ship board. calls ShipBoard.removeGoods(Point, GoodsType) to remove a good from the ship board. Adds the removed good to the buffer.
      Overrides:
      removeGood in class GameState
      Parameters:
      shipBoard - the ship board losing the good
      position - the position of the good to remove
      good - the type of good to remove
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if it's not the player's turn
